$comment: Provisional: the reference definition of the implementation guide (Section 11.4), from the kinds and attributes of [FW] Section 3.6, stands in for [IMPL] Annex B until it arrives; work item D.3 replaces it.
title: ControllerBindingEntry
description: A controller binding: its kind of controller, interface and versions, the action types it supports and its southbound adapter.

owner.description: The owner of the entry: the domain owner, framework or kpi-definitions.

deprecated.description: A deprecated entry stays resolvable; admission warns new descriptors.

versions.description: The range of interface versions the adapter supports, for example >=7.0 <8.0.

operations.description: The operations of the interface the adapter performs.

adapter.description: The southbound adapter, as module:class of u6g-adapters.

stateReflectsDevice.description: Whether the controller's state queries reflect the device, so that controllerQuery may verify (guide Section 8.3).
